text: APR, a Rwandan basketball club affiliated with Rwanda's armed forces, withdrew from the 2026 Basketball Africa League in March 2026 after the US Treasury's Office of Foreign Assets Control sanctioned the Rwanda Defence Force (RDF) over its support for the M23 armed group in the Democratic Republic of Congo. OFAC's own sanctions listing gives the RDF's address as Rwanda's Ministry of Defence. Because the BAL operates under the NBA, an American entity, continuing to field APR risked exposing the league to sanctions-compliance issues, and Rwanda's basketball federation, FERWABA, named RSSB Tigers as APR's replacement.

source.name: ChimpReports - Rwanda Army-Linked Team APR Exits Basketball Africa League After U.S. Sanctions
source.quote: Rwanda's military-affiliated basketball club has been forced to withdraw from the 2026 season of the Basketball Africa League after U.S. sanctions targeted the Rwanda Defence Force
